name: F-16
source: Aerodynamic and engine tables: L. T. Nguyen, M. E. Ogburn, W. P. Gilbert, K. S. Kibler, P. W. Brown, P. L. Deal, 'Simulator Study of Stall/Post-Stall Characteristics of a Fighter Airplane With Relaxed Longitudinal Static Stability', NASA TP-1538 (1979), in the low-angle-of-attack form tabulated by B. L. Stevens and F. L. Lewis, 'Aircraft Control and Simulation' (Wiley), appendix A (F-16 model, alpha -10..45 deg, beta 0..30 deg, Mach < ~0.6). Mass properties, geometry, engine lag law: same source. Everything marked 'estimate' below is our own, not from that report.
licence: Numbers from a NASA technical paper (U.S. Government work, public domain in the U.S.); numerical facts are not copyrightable. No JSBSim (LGPL) or other file was copied. Estimates: own work.
units: SI unless named; angles of the tables in degrees; aero tables dimensionless (body axes x forward, y right, z down, as in the source)

geometry._src: S = 300 ft², b = 30 ft, cbar = 11.32 ft, xcg ref 0.35 cbar

mass._src: W 20 490 lb, Jx 9496, Jy 55 814, Jz 63 100, Jxz 982 slug·ft², engine angular momentum 160 slug·ft²/s (TP-1538 / Stevens & Lewis)

fuel._src: start: 1 800 kg makes the mass equal to the TP-1538 reference 9 295 kg (unchanged). Tanks: Falcon BMS 4.38 Data/Sim/Acdata/F-16CM-50.txtpb, fuel { fuel_fwd_res 462, fuel_aft_res 462, fuel_fwd1 2016, fuel_fwd2 716, fuel_aft1 2310, fuel_wing_al 598, fuel_wing_fr 598 } lb JP-8 = 7 162 lb (= airframe.internal_fuel_lbs); places from fuel_tanks.fuel_tank[0-6].gc_ft (ft, x from the nose, y right, z down) -> pos = metres [right, up, aft of cg_location_ft 27] (z = 0 taken as the CG height; left wing = -y as fuel_leak_posit_lwing_tank). Public cross-check (unofficial flashcards): fwd system 3 800 lb, aft 3 360 lb (BMS 3 792 / 3 370). Systems, transfer path and feed: TO 1F-16CM-1 BMS (Docs/02 .../TO 1F-16CMAM-1 BMS.pdf) ch. 3: fwd = right ext + right wing + F-1 + F-2 + fwd reservoir, aft = left ext + left wing + A-1 + aft reservoir, centreline = both; ext -> internal wing tanks (centreline first in NORM), wing -> fuselage -> reservoirs, the FFP takes equal flow from each reservoir. rates in 1000 lb/h: syphon = fuel_fuselage_syphon_rate 80 (fuselage -> reservoir, F-1 -> F-2), cline = fuel_cline_rate 18, extWing = fuel_wing_ext_rate 15 per tank (units: the Dash-1 p. 186 gives 18 000 pph from the 300-gal tank and 30 000 pph from the 370-gal pair, which fixes BMS's unit as klb/h). wingInt 15 = ESTIMATE: BMS fuel_wing_al/fr_rate is 3, but then external fuel could not keep the fuselage full below 30 000 pph as the Dash-1 says; disagreement noted. lowLb: Dash-1 3.7 FWD / AFT FUEL LOW (reservoir below 400 / 250 lb) = BMS fuel_min_fwd / fuel_min_aft. trp: Dash-1 3.9 TRP FUEL conditions. Not modelled: automatic forward fuel transfer (inactive with this layout: fwd-heavy differential 422 lb > its 300 lb start), ENG FEED / FUEL QTY SEL knobs, unusable fuel, negative-g feed limits.

stores._src: stations: store slots of the BMS exterior model 1052 (node type 6 / 7, Parent.dat AddSlot 1-9), web craft frame (m, x right, y up, z aft) with the airframe's ALIGN, by tools/build_bms_stores.py's slot reading. Stores: Data/TerrData/Objects/Falcon4_WCD.xml: 93 'Tank 370gal' Weight 820 lb, Drag 34, Strength 2516 (= fuel lb, 370 gal x 6.8 lb/gal JP-8); 85 'Tank 300gal' 392 lb, Drag 17, 2040 lb fuel; 620 'R F-16 Center' (the centreline pylon, CT 2815) 172 lb, Drag 16. BmsRack.dat: the 370-gal tank hangs without a rack (tank and pylon one unit, jettisoned together: 'f16-370-wing-tank-no-rack', weapjettmodes EMERGENCY); the 300-gal tank on rack 'f16-center-tank' (rackct 2815, rackjettmodes NONE: the pylon stays). cm = centroid of the closed BMS mesh (models 1380 / 918 / 1657) from the attachment point; the same place is used for the fuel (ESTIMATE: the fuel's own centroid moves as it drains). Mesh volume check: 370 model 1.62 m3 incl. pylon (370 gal = 1.40 m3), 300 model 1.20 m3 (300 gal = 1.14 m3). Drag: BMS F-16CM-50.txtpb aero limit LIM_STORES_DRAG (LIMITER_LINE 0.9 -> 0.0001, 1.0 -> 0.000283), read as the drag-coefficient increment per drag unit (S = 300 ft2) vs Mach, clamped outside 0.9-1.0 (ESTIMATE of the reading; 0.0001 per unit is the usual drag-index convention). Unofficial cross-checks: wing-tank pylon DI 8, centreline pylon DI 7 (DCS forum); '370 tank ~700 lb dry with pylon' (forum). No store g / speed limits in the BMS data or the BMS Dash-1: none applied. cdA (m2) of a falling tank: ESTIMATE (axial Cd ~0.3 x the frontal area of the mesh, 0.44 / 0.56 m2).

controls._src: limits (deg), actuator lag 20.2 rad/s and rate limits (deg/s): Stevens & Lewis

linear._src: CY = -.02 beta(deg) + .021 ail/20 + .086 rud/30; CZ += -.19 elev/25 (Stevens & Lewis)

mach._src: estimate (the source tables are low-speed): transonic / supersonic zero-lift drag rise dCD (peak ~0.03, typical of fighters of this class, Raymer 'Aircraft Design' ch. 12 shape), lift-slope factor kL (Prandtl-Glauert below M 0.9, Ackeret-like fall above), aft shift of the aerodynamic centre dXac (cbar)

postStall._src: estimate: beyond the table (alpha > 45 or < -10 deg) the coefficients blend into a flat-plate-like body (normal force CN90 sin(alpha), pitch-down moment); the real TP-1538 data to 90 deg (deep stall near 60 deg) are not tabulated here

speedBrake._src: dCX, dCM = increments at 60 deg, scaled by deflection / 60 (body axes, as the other tables): NASA TP-1538, appendix B equations (p. 37-38) and table III (p. 51 dCX,sb, p. 65 dCm,sb); max 60 deg: TP-1538 table I. TP-1538 also lists dCZ,sb (p. 58: -0.386 at alpha 0, i.e. a lift gain of 1.6 g at 300 kt) - left out: it disagrees with the small dCm,sb of a surface 1.5 chords behind the CG and with the flight manual (no lift change named); suspected scan / data error. gearMax 43 deg with the right main gear down and locked (lower petals clear the runway; nose wheel on the ground -> 60 again): F-16 flight manual T.O. 1F-16A-1 as quoted in the Falcon BMS forum and the Aerosoft F-16 manual. rate 30 deg/s (60 deg in ~2 s): estimate, no published figure found.

engine.name: F100-PW-200 class turbofan with afterburner
engine._tables: thrust in lbf, rows = Mach 0..1, columns = altitude 0..50 000 ft (Stevens & Lewis from TP-1538)

superMach._src: estimate above Mach 1 (the tables stop at 1.0): thrust(M) = thrust(1.0) x (1 + k (M - 1)), k grows with altitude (ram recovery); falls to 0 between Mlimit and Mzero (fixed inlet)

tsfc._src: estimate from public F100-PW-200/220 data: TSFC ~0.7 dry / ~2.0 lb/(lbf·h) in afterburner; x (1 + 0.3 M) x sqrt(T/288 K)

start._src: BMS = Falcon BMS 4.38 Data/Sim/Acdata/F-16A-15.txtpb (engine F100-PW-220), block `engine`; TO = 'TO 1F-16CMAM-1 BMS.pdf' (BMS Docs); CL = 'PRINT_T.O. BMS1F-16CM-1CL-1.pdf' (BMS checklist, Blk40-52); TM = BMS-Training-Manual.pdf 4.38.1 ch. 1.8. idleRpm 70: BMS alt_mach_idle_rpm_chart 0.70 below Mach 0.5 (CL PW220 idle check: 65-77 %). jfsSpinUp 15 s to governed speed (JFS RUN): BMS jfs_start_up_time 15 (our reading: seconds; TO 2.28: JFS RUN within 30 s). jfsSpinDown 17 s: TO 2.29. jfsCrankRpm 28 and crankTau 3 s: ESTIMATE (TO airstart: the JFS motors the engine at a minimum of 25 %; BMS jfs_spool_up_limit 0.25). throttleIdleAt 25 %: TM ('let rpm reach 25 % before IDLE'); CL: IDLE at 20 % minimum. minFuelRpm 12 %: TO airstart (below 12 % the main fuel pump gives too little fuel; accumulators recharge at >= 12 %; BMS jfs_min_recharge_rpm 0.12). lightoffDelay 3 s: ESTIMATE (CL: light-off within 10 s of throttle advance). noStart 20 s: TO 38.3.3. accelMax 2.6 %/s, accelTau 2.5 s: ESTIMATE giving light-off -> idle in ~20 s (BMS lightup_spool_rate 20, our unverified reading as seconds; TO airstart: ~45 s from throttle advance to idle). jfsCutout 50 %: TO 2.29 + CL (TM says ~55 %). jfsMaxRun 240 s: BMS jfs_spin_time 240 (our reading). accRecharge 60 s: BMS jfs_recharge_time 60, TO airstart (1 min of rotation at >= 12 %). spoolDownTau / spoolDownDrag / offRpm: ESTIMATE (idle -> 0 in ~34 s; MAIN PWR off below 5 %). windmill: ESTIMATE (rpm of a dead engine in flight = 60 x Mach, max 45 %). jfsEnvelope: TO airstart (start the JFS below 20 000 ft MSL and 400 kt). ftit (deg C): idle 477 = BMS ftit_idle 4.77, mil 907 = BMS ftit_max 9.07 (gauge units of 100 deg C, our reading); start curve (rpm % -> deg C, followed with the lag tau): TM (40 % = 400, 50 % = 500, peak 600-650, ~500 at idle); the 640 node is set so the measured peak lands near BMS ftit_start 6.17 (617 deg C); tau / coolTau: ESTIMATE

electric._src: stbyGenRpm 55 %: BMS stby_gen_rpm 0.55 and TO 6.9 (STBY GEN light off at ~55 % for PW220). mainGenRpm 63 %: BMS main_gen_rpm 0.63. mainGenDelay 8 s: TO 6.9 (~10 s after STBY GEN), CL (5-10 s). flcsPmgRpm 40 %: TO 6.9 (FLCS PMG light off at ~40 % for PW220). genHyst 3 %: ESTIMATE. Battery drain not modelled (CL: max 5 min on battery without the engine).

epu._src: burnTime 600 s on hydrazine alone: BMS epu_burn_time 600, TO 8.3 (~10 min under normal load). spinUp 2 s: TO 8.3. spinDown 3 s: ESTIMATE. bleedRpm (pressure altitude ft -> rpm %): TO 8.3 (engine bleed air runs the EPU without hydrazine at 75-85 % rpm for PW220, depending on pressure altitude; the linear mapping over 0-30 000 ft is ESTIMATE). Automatic start: both generators off line (TO ch. 8, EPU description); only in flight here (ESTIMATE: weight-on-wheels inhibit); latched until the switch is reset.

gear._src: estimate from public F-16 dimensions (wheelbase ~4.0 m, track ~2.4 m, length 15.0 m, span 9.45 m incl. missiles rails); springs set for ~0.1 m static compression, damping ~0.6 of critical; x = right, y = up, z = aft (metres from the reference CG)

fcs._src: own simple stability augmentation (not the F-16 FLCS): g-limits +9 / -3 and the 25 deg AoA limit are the published F-16 values; gains are ours

trim._src: TO 1F-16CM/AM-1 BMS (Falcon BMS 4.38, Docs/02 Aircraft Manuals & Checklists/01 F-16), sect. 35.6 Trim: in cruise gains pitch trim sets the hands-off g, full nose up / down = +3.4 / -1.4 g (pitchMax / pitchMin = +-2.4 g from 1 g); roll trim sets the hands-off roll rate, maximum authority about one-fifth of the maximum stick command (rollMaxShare x fcs.rollRate = 36 deg/s here); sect. 17.13.1: stick trim inoperative with the autopilot engaged. Rates from BMS Data/Sim/Acdata/F-16CM-50.txtpb trim { pitch_elevator_trim_rate: 0.15, pitch_aileron_trim_rate: 0.04, max_trim_value: 0.5 }, read by us as stick fractions per s with the full trim at 0.5 -> full travel 3.3 s (pitch) and 12.5 s (roll): 2.4 g / 3.33 s = 0.72 g/s, 36 / 12.5 = 2.88 deg/s per s (our reading of the BMS keys, units not documented). ESTIMATE: one press = 0.005 g / 0.25 deg/s (fine enough to trim out the ~0.003 g that level flight over the curved, turning Earth needs less than 1 g), hold delay 0.4 s. Trim acts only in the air (SAS mode); on the ground the direct law is unchanged (the real FLCS has takeoff / landing gains, not modelled).

autopilot._src: TO 1F-16CM/AM-1 BMS (Falcon BMS 4.38 docs) sect. 17.13 Autopilot: PITCH switch ALT HOLD / A/P OFF / ATT HOLD engages pitch + roll; ROLL switch HDG SEL / ATT HOLD (STRG SEL not modelled); back to A/P OFF with LG handle DN, AOA > 15 deg, low speed warning tone (here: our stall flag), TRIM/AP DISC (+ AR door, ALT FLAPS, DBU, MPO, STBY GAIN, A/P FAIL: not modelled); ALT HOLD command limited to +0.5..+2 g, +-100 ft accuracy, capture not sure above 2000 ft/min; ATT HOLD and the roll modes do not work beyond +-60 deg pitch / bank but stay engaged and resume inside; HDG SEL / STRG SEL: bank <= 30 deg, roll rate <= 20 deg/s (pMax); paddle switch interrupts while held, references taken anew on release; stick steering in ATT HOLD axes drops the reference (new one on release); sect. 35.5: A/P command additive to stick commands. maxMach 0.95: BMS Data/Sim/Acdata/F-16CM-50.txtpb autopilot { max_autopilot_mach }. The BMS pitch / roll PID gains in that block are in BMS's internal units and are not used. ESTIMATE (our own loop design): tau*, kiPhi, kHdg, vsMaxFpm as the capture limit, attNz (ATT HOLD g limits = ALT HOLD), stickSteer (stick deflection that starts stick steering; the jet uses a force threshold, not published).

gun.name: M61A1 20 mm
gun._src: rounds 510: DCS CoreMods/aircraft/F-16C/F-16C.lua gun_mount('M_61', count = 510), ammo mix {7, 8} = PGU-27/B TP + PGU-30/B TP-T -> tracerEvery 2; rpm 6000: BMS Data/TerrData/Objects/Falcon4_WCD.xml WCD 492 '20mm M61' BulletRoundsPerSec 100, DCS F-15E.lua rates {6000, 4000}; muzzle (m, body axes): BMS Data/Sim/Acdata/F-16CM-50.txtpb gun { gun_location { x 11.43 y -2.31 z -0.92 } } (ft, x fwd y right z down) mapped to our axes + the model offset of gfx.js, checked against the barrel bore of the BMS exterior model (1 cm); elev / az 0: same file gun_elevation 0 gun_azimuth 0; v0 3440 ft/s and Cd(M) above M 1.15: fitted to the velocity-vs-slant-range and time-of-flight charts of R. Kemp (GD-OTS), '20mm PGU-28A/B', NDIA 42nd Gun & Missile Systems Conference 2007 (USAF public release 4/17/07), slides 9-10 (6000 ft, 450 kt; fit within ~20 ft/s and 0.02 s to 6000 ft); PGU-27/30 are ballistically matched to PGU-28 (same briefing series); mass 100 g (GD-OTS data sheet). ESTIMATE: Cd below M 1.15, charge 39 g (recoil), spinUp 0.4 s, spinDown 0.5 s, dispersion 2.2 mrad sigma per axis (~8 mil for 80 %), traceTime 2.5 s, pipperRange 610 m (2000 ft) when no target is tracked
